A colouring studio by StoryWell Books

About Chromalie

Chromalie is a free space for colouring, experimenting with brushes and spending time with a picture. Choose from the library, try a new palette, and keep what you make.

Why the name Chromalie?

Chromalie takes its inspiration from chroma, a word associated with colour. We wanted a name that felt imaginative, welcoming and a little whimsical, much like opening a colouring book. Chromalie is a place to explore colour at your own pace, with no prescribed palette and no single right way to finish a page.

What you can do here

Colour within detected outlines, paint freehand, experiment with textured digital brushes and build your own palette. Your work can be saved locally in your browser or downloaded to keep. Read the Help & Features guide for instructions.

Made by StoryWell Books

Chromalie is a project from StoryWell Books. The library includes artwork from different sources, with credits where applicable. Rights to individual artworks remain with their respective holders.

Your artwork, your device

Chromalie does not require an account. When enabled, progress is stored in your browser on this device, rather than synchronised across devices. Download copies of paintings you want to keep. See our privacy notice and storage information.
